title: Unleashing The Power of Pre-Trained Language Models for Irregularly Sampled Time Series

problem.claim: Irregularly sampled time series have uneven sampling intervals and prevalent missing data, creating distinct analytical challenges for language-model-based time series analysis.

gap.claim: Existing efforts to adapt pre-trained language models to time series predominantly focus on regularly sampled time series and neglect irregularly sampled time series.

contributions.claim: The work investigates methods for representing irregularly sampled time series to improve the efficacy of pre-trained language models.
The work proposes ISTS-PLM, a unified pre-trained-language-model-based framework for diverse irregularly sampled time series analytical tasks.
ISTS-PLM integrates time-aware and variable-aware pre-trained language models for intra- and inter-time series modeling.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments on a comprehensive benchmark reportedly show that ISTS-PLM consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple analytical tasks.
The reported task coverage includes classification, interpolation, extrapolation, few-shot learning, and zero-shot learning.
The reported application domains include healthcare, biomechanics, and climate science.

narrative_sequence.summary: Pre-trained language models have advanced natural language processing and motivated adaptation to time series analysis.
Prior adaptation efforts mainly address regularly sampled time series, leaving irregular sampling and missing data insufficiently addressed.
The work studies representations for irregularly sampled time series and proposes the ISTS-PLM framework with time-aware and variable-aware models.
Benchmark experiments reportedly show consistent state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks and scientific domains.

source_observation.claim: The framework combines a structured series-based representation with time-aware and variable-aware modeling for irregularly sampled time series.

interpretation.claim: Handling irregular sampling may require adapting both the input representation and the model's treatment of temporal and variable relationships.

application.claim: When applying pre-trained language models to irregularly sampled temporal data, evaluate representation design together with temporal and variable-aware modeling.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this approach generalizes beyond the reported tasks, domains, or benchmark.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the benchmark datasets, baselines, or quantitative results.
The abstract does not describe the precise series-based representation or model architecture.
The abstract does not report computational costs, limitations, or failure cases.
